visual_enhancers.animations: Framer Motion for entrance (staggered fade-up) and hover states (scale 1.02)

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Override the CSS variables in 'index.css' with the provided Dark Mode palette. Force dark mode by default.
3. LAYOUT: Create a 'DashboardLayout' component that includes the Sidebar and TopBar. Use 'Outlet' for page content.
4. WIDGETS: Build modular widgets (NodeHealth, Earnings, InstalledApps). Use the 'Bento Grid' strategy.
5. GLASS: Apply the glassmorphism classes to all cards and sidebar. Ensure text contrast is high (APCA compliant).
6. CHARTS: Implement the Earnings chart using Recharts with the specified gradients.
7. NAVIGATION: Implement the Sidebar with the requested links (Dashboard, App Factory, etc.). Active state should have a 'glow' effect.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
